title: AgriWorld: A World Tools Protocol Framework for Verifiable Agricultural Reasoning with Code-Executing LLM Agents

claim.summary: AgriWorld provides an executable agricultural environment, reflective code agent and checker-based evaluation over heterogeneous spatiotemporal data.

tasks.source_label: Forecasting and prediction; Anomaly detection and diagnosis; Decision support; temporal question answering

modules.name: Execute–observe–refine code loop
modules.scope_reason: Execution observations and diagnostics drive corrective code patches; the loop is generic.
evidence_locators: PDF p.4; passage beginning "We introduce AGRO-REFLECTIVE"

modules.name: Typed spatiotemporal data and tool artifacts
modules.scope_reason: Raster time series, weather streams and management-event state are exposed with physical metadata across forecasting, monitoring and intervention tasks.
evidence_locators: PDF p.3; passage beginning "Unified Tool Interface and Artifacts"

modules.name: Simulator-grounded intervention validation
modules.scope_reason: Checks compare agricultural intervention effects against a simulator and prescribed direction/threshold.

modules.name: Agricultural Qwen LoRA adaptation
modules.scope_reason: The implementation explicitly fine-tunes Qwen on the training split; distinguish this from the code-agent runtime.
evidence_locators: PDF p.5; passage beginning "We finetune the Qwen3"
